ex.s: Although my kindergarten experience feels like a century ago, the lessons I learned will stick in my mind forever.
ex.t: 虽然我的幼儿园感觉像是很久以前的事了，但我学到的教训将永远铭记在心。

ex.s: To a child, every minute feels like forever.
ex.t: 对孩子来说，每一分钟都像永远那么漫长。

ex.s: It seemed to go on forever!” So surprise your audience.
ex.t: “它似乎会永远持续下去！”所以要让你的听众感到惊喜。

ex.s: While running regularly can’t make you live forever, the review says it  64 (be) more effective at lengthening life  65 walking, cycling or swimming.
ex.t: 虽然经常跑步不能让你长生不老，但综述说它比步行、骑自行车或游泳更能____64____（是）延长生命____65____。

ex.s: Climate change is a continuing process, so Norphel’s ice reserves will not last forever.
ex.t: 气候变化是一个持续的过程，所以诺普尔的冰储不会永远存在。

ex.s: My most frightening but magical experience was now captured forever in a single image.
ex.t: 我最可怕但也最神奇的经历现在永远地凝固在一张照片里了。

ex.s: She surfaces, cries in fear, then disappears forever.
ex.t: 她浮出水面，恐惧地哭喊，然后永远消失了。

ex.s: These things changed the world forever.
ex.t: 这些事情永远地改变了世界。

ex.s: It has changed ideas about life on Earth forever.
ex.t: 它永远地改变了人们对地球生命的认识。

defs.def: a very long time 长久地
（与动词进行时连用）老是，没完没了地

ex.s: Grown-ups never understand anything by themselves, and it is tiresome for children to be always and forever explaining things to them.
ex.t: 大人们自己什么也不懂，孩子们总是要不停地向他们解释，这真让人厌烦。
